title: Make registration ACK reload assertion describe post-shutdown persistence accurately
outcome: The ACK regression's reload assertion states the persistence boundary that it actually observes.
acceptance: The reload assertion and explanatory text describe persistence across shutdown/reload without claiming this assertion proves commit at acknowledgement time.
Retain the existing sibling's controlled ACK-after-SQLite-commit coverage and current registration/replay/identity controls; no new timing, deadline or product behavior is introduced.
